$comment: Shared strict compiler options only — no target/lib/jsx/paths/include, since those vary per tsconfig (app vs. node vs. e2e) even within one repo. A consuming repo's own tsconfig.*.json should set "extends": "path/to/this/file" and add those itself. Extracted from routines' tsconfig.app.json/tsconfig.node.json, which stay the reference implementation — see maat-apps/maat-core#1.
